description: 국가철도공단_해외 철도 사업정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. ○ 제목 → 해당 철도 사업에 대한 공식적인 명칭입니다. 예를 들어, '프랑스 고속철도 TGV'나 '영국 런던-맨체스터 철도 노선' 등이 포함됩니다. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
